hints.title: Subtree State Formulation
hints.text: For each node, compute the best result if the edge to its parent is retained versus if the edge to its parent is removed.

hints.title: Marginal Gain Calculation
hints.text: For each child, compute the marginal gain of keeping the edge to that child compared to discarding it.

hints.title: Greedy Child Selection
hints.text: Sort the positive marginal gains descendingly and select up to k edges (or k - 1 if the parent edge is kept).

hints.title: Reference Implementation
hints.text:
```python
import sys
sys.setrecursionlimit(300_000)

class Solution:
    def maximizeSumOfWeights(self, edges: list[list[int]], k: int) -> int:
        n = len(edges) + 1
        adj = [[] for _ in range(n)]
        for u, v, w in edges:
            adj[u].append((v, w))
            adj[v].append((u, w))
            
        def dfs(u: int, p: int) -> tuple[int, int]:
            base_sum = 0
            gains = []
            for v, w in adj[u]:
                if v == p:
                    continue
                v0, v1 = dfs(v, u)
                base_sum += v0
                gain = w + v1 - v0
                if gain > 0:
                    gains.append(gain)
                    
            gains.sort(reverse=True)
            res0 = base_sum + sum(gains[:k])
            res1 = base_sum + sum(gains[:max(0, k - 1)])
            return res0, res1
            
        return dfs(0, -1)[0]
```

variables: n: number of nodes in tree
complexity.notes: Tree DP with greedy child edge selection based on marginal positive weight gains.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Checking all 2^(n-1) edge removal configurations is intractable.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(n) auxiliary memory for tree adjacency and DFS recursion stack.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Formulates tree DP state tracking whether the edge to the parent node is kept.
